news.headline: Brent at $110, WTI $98 (+1.2-1.4%) – crude stays elevated
news.what_happened: Brent rose ~1.4% to $110.3; WTI $98.3. Nifty closed 22,811 (-0.34%) on Oct 21, second straight fall.
news.why_it_matters: Higher crude lifts upstream realisations (ONGC, OIL) and pressures airlines, paints, tyres, logistics and import bill/INR.

news.headline: Nasdaq +1.05%, S&P 500 +0.58% overnight
news.what_happened: US equities rose; Nasdaq above 26,700. Nifty IT was the only gainer on Oct 21 (+2.52%).
news.why_it_matters: Supports Indian IT re-rating; USD/INR flat near 94.45 keeps USD earnings tailwind.

news.headline: Persistent FII selling, US 10Y at 5.15%
news.what_happened: FIIs kept selling on Oct 21; US 10Y yield rose to ~5.15%. Auto, metal, realty, private banks fell 1.2-2%.
news.why_it_matters: Risk-off for rate-sensitive and cyclical sectors; mid/small caps vulnerable.

news.headline: Asia weak: Hang Seng -2.33%, Nikkei -1.09%
news.why_it_matters: Weak China cue is negative for metals; soft open risk for Nifty.

sector_outlook.reason: FII selling and US yields 5.1% offset by US risk-on
